integrity: The four-good proof reduces all nonnegative additive valuations to an exhaustive strict-ordinal 24^5-case check with exact 36-bit masks. Standalone C++17 and Python sources, a deterministic output, and sharpness examples are supplied. Independent scholarly validation has not been performed.
limitations: The strict-rank frequency law is specific to exactly three fixed couples and four goods. The universal existence guarantee requires nonnegative additive valuations; it is not extended to chores, nonadditivity, larger groups or more goods.
title: Sharp four-good EF1 multiplicity frontier for three fixed couples
